title: Lee County and Fort Myers Beach — Mosquito-control district merger

jurisdiction.name: Lee County Mosquito Control and Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control districts

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Makes Chapter 2025-235 effective. It expands the Lee County Mosquito Control District to include all of Lee County, abolishes the Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control District, and transfers that district’s assets and liabilities to the Lee County Mosquito Control District.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve making this mosquito-control district merger and transfer effective.
measureRecord.noMeans: Reject making this district merger effective through this referendum.

officialQuestion:
Page 1 of 1 
 
 
 
 
Lee County, Florida 
General Election, November 3, 2026 
 
Mosquito Control District Referendum 
 
Merger of Mosquito Districts, Lee County Mosquito Control District to Include all of Lee County 
 
Shall Chapter 2025-235, Laws of Florida, amending the boundaries of the Lee County Mosquito Control District 
to include all of Lee County, abolishing the Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control District, and transferring the 
assets and liabilities of the Fort Myers Beach Mosquito Control District to the Lee County Mosquito Control 
District, become effective? 
 
Yes 
No
scopeResolution: Voting electorate is residents of the two named mosquito-control districts, per official index. Existing exact district jurisdiction/boundary unresolved; do not assign county-wide.

title: Fort Myers Beach and Iona-McGregor — Fire district merger

jurisdiction.name: Fort Myers Beach Fire Control and Iona-McGregor Fire Protection and Rescue Service districts

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Makes Chapter 2026-192 effective. It expands the Iona-McGregor Fire Protection and Rescue Service District to include the territory of the Fort Myers Beach Fire Control District, abolishes the Fort Myers Beach district, provides a transitional board, and transfers its assets and liabilities to the Iona-McGregor district.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve making this fire-district merger, transitional board and transfer effective.
measureRecord.noMeans: Reject making this district merger effective through this referendum.

officialQuestion:
Page 1 of 1 
 
 
 
Lee County, Florida 
General Election, November 3, 2026 
 
Fire District Referendum 
 
Merger of Fort Myers Beach and Iona-McGregor Fire Control and Rescue Service Districts 
 
Shall Chapter 2026-192, Laws of Florida, amending the boundaries of the Iona-McGregor Fire Protection and 
Rescue Service District to include all territories currently included in the Fort Myers Beach Fire Control District, 
abolishing the Fort Myers Beach Fire Control District, providing for a transitional board, and transferring the 
assets and liabilities of the Fort Myers Beach Fire Control District to the Iona-McGregor Fire Protection and 
Rescue Service District, become effective? 
 
Yes 
No
scopeResolution: Only voters in the two named fire districts. Existing exact district jurisdiction/boundary unresolved; do not assign county-wide.
